notes: This contract pins one bounded IEEE 1516.2-2025 FOM-composition rule: a supplied array-data Element Type must name a simple, enumerated, reference, fixed-record, array, or variant-record data type, not a raw basic-data representation. The completed-model preflight resolves names before applying that category predicate, preserves omitted Element Type and the established NA marker for incomplete DIF rows, and accepts the standard MIM/Restaurant arrays. This is private source/test traceability only, not a FOM conformance or public-service evidence claim.
